Description

The admin tree (in-game called "admin") Is a tree only found in the testing servers, The appearance of an admin tree is a bright yellowish neon, with a pitch black inside,

Trivia

  • The admin tree's black inside is caused by an odd feature when making neon black. Causing it to become pitch black and absorb ALL light.
  • It, along with electrified bamboo, are the only trees that have a neon plank texture.
